docs.summary: Fluent builder for a standalone legend: a top-down list of colour swatches and labels. Construct via `Origami.Legend`; chain modifiers; call [`Show`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.LegendBuilder~Show) to render. Used internally by every Origami chart family for a single, consistent legend look, but takes no dependency on charts itself - any widget with a list of coloured, nameable things can build its own [`LegendEntry`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.LegendEntry) list and drop this in.
docs.remarks: This widget owns no state of its own: whether a row reads as hidden is entirely driven by [`Hidden`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.LegendEntry~Hidden), and a click only reports the row's key via [`OnToggle`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.LegendBuilder~OnToggle). The caller decides what "hidden" means and where to store it.

docs.summary: Width, in pixels, of the legend column. Defaults to 125.
Top inset of the legend column, so its first row lines up with whatever sits beside it (a chart's plot area, say) rather than its own container's edge. Defaults to 0.
Size, in pixels, of each row's colour swatch. Also sets the row height. Defaults to 12.
Gap, in pixels, between rows. Defaults to 2.
Font size, in pixels, of the row labels. Unset uses the theme's XS size.

Let a click on a row's swatch report that row's key via [`OnToggle`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.LegendBuilder~OnToggle). Also gated by [`LegendSelectionEnabled`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~LegendSelectionEnabled), so a host can disable the interaction everywhere without every call site having to check it.

Called with a row's [`Key`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.LegendEntry~Key) when it is clicked, while [`Interactive`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.LegendBuilder~Interactive) is active. The legend itself stores no hidden state; the caller is responsible for flipping whatever it keys hidden-ness by and passing the updated [`Hidden`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.LegendEntry~Hidden) back in next frame.
